scope: Claim-level review queue for seven already-public bilingual circuit short stories. Source leads and excerpts are NOT independent verification, editorial approval, or a release decision.

claims.en_excerpt: This was Senna's first Formula 1 World Championship victory
claims.uk_excerpt: Це була перша перемога Сенни в чемпіонаті світу
claims.review_question: Confirm first career championship victory, identity and event in original results and chronology.

claims.en_excerpt: At Estoril in 1985, the rain was not merely a backdrop
claims.uk_excerpt: В Ешторілі 1985 року дощ був не декорацією, а головним випробуванням
claims.review_question: Locate an explicit weather passage; a classification file does not establish rainfall.

claims.en_excerpt: standing water caught out rivals, including Alain Prost
claims.uk_excerpt: вода на трасі ставала проблемою для суперників, зокрема Алена Проста
claims.review_question: Distinguish a retrospective interpretation from a verifiable race fact; soften if unsupported.

claims.en_excerpt: Alonso's win remains in the official classification
claims.uk_excerpt: У протоколі переможцем лишився Алонсо
claims.review_question: Confirm winner in classification; confirm early stop in the race account, not in result rows.

claims.en_excerpt: Fernando Alonso's 2008 Singapore victory looked astonishing on the night
claims.uk_excerpt: Увечері Гран-прі Сінгапуру 2008 року перемога Фернандо Алонсо здавалася
claims.review_question: Confirm the inaugural night-race context from a contemporary source independently of the race classification.

claims.en_excerpt: At a World Motor Sport Council hearing Renault admitted that senior team figures and Piquet had conspired to cause the crash deliberately
claims.uk_excerpt: на засіданні Всесвітньої ради FIA Renault визнала змову керівників команди й Піке з метою навмисно спричинити зіткнення
claims.review_question: Verify the 21 September 2009 WMSC admission and FIA investigation findings; do not imply Alonso participated or that the 2008 result was retrospectively annulled.

claims.en_excerpt: Prost won the race and the championship
claims.uk_excerpt: Прост виграв гонку й титул
claims.review_question: Confirm race result and championship outcome independently; race-result rows alone are not official season standings.

claims.en_excerpt: Then his left-rear tyre failed at speed
claims.uk_excerpt: Потім на швидкості зруйнувалася його ліва задня шина
claims.review_question: Check whether the evidence supports the more specific Ukrainian 'puncture' versus English 'tyre failure'.

claims.en_excerpt: it cannot convey how abruptly a season turned in the final miles
claims.uk_excerpt: але не передає, як раптово змінився весь сезон
claims.review_question: Decide whether the superlative is appropriate opinion rather than a sourced measurable claim.

claims.en_excerpt: on Sunday John Watson won a race
claims.uk_excerpt: у неділю Джон Вотсон виграв гонку
claims.review_question: Verify winner and venue against the 1982 classification.

claims.en_excerpt: Gilles Villeneuve died after a qualifying accident on Saturday
claims.uk_excerpt: У суботу після аварії в кваліфікації загинув Жиль Вільньов
claims.review_question: Verify session, date, circumstances and sensitive wording with a dedicated historical account.

claims.en_excerpt: The classification describes Sunday's race; the loss that preceded it is a separate, painful part
claims.uk_excerpt: Протокол описує недільний результат; трагедія напередодні — окрема й болюча частина
claims.review_question: Check respectful tone without presenting the editorial framing as independently verified.

claims.en_excerpt: Ayrton Senna put his Williams on pole for the 1994 Pacific Grand Prix, ahead of Michael Schumacher
claims.uk_excerpt: Айртон Сенна здобув поул на Гран-прі Тихого океану 1994 року, випередивши Міхаеля Шумахера
claims.review_question: Verify qualifying grid with the separate official qualifying record.

claims.en_excerpt: Senna was eliminated at the start
claims.uk_excerpt: Сенна вибув одразу після старту
claims.review_question: Find race chronology for the start collision; a result row alone does not prove cause.

claims.en_excerpt: Schumacher brought his Benetton home first
claims.uk_excerpt: Шумахер довів свій Benetton до перемоги
claims.review_question: Verify winner and constructor in pinned classification.

claims.en_excerpt: Gerhard Berger finished second, 75.3 seconds behind
claims.uk_excerpt: Герхард Бергер фінішував другим із відставанням 75,3 секунди
claims.review_question: Check numeric gap and rounding in primary race classification; compare EN and UK punctuation.

claims.en_excerpt: Rubens Barrichello took third for Jordan
claims.uk_excerpt: Рубенс Баррікелло привіз Jordan на третє місце
claims.review_question: Verify third place and constructor, including classification status.

claims.en_excerpt: Jacky Ickx, driving a Ferrari, ahead of John Surtees and Jackie Stewart
claims.uk_excerpt: Жакі Ікс на Ferrari випередив Джона Сертіса та Джекі Стюарта
claims.review_question: Verify finishing order, car identity and race year.

claims.en_excerpt: Jo Schlesser was killed when his Honda crashed early in the race
claims.uk_excerpt: Жо Шлессер загинув у аварії на Honda
claims.review_question: Check date, timing and cause in an appropriate historical account; use restrained language.

claims.en_excerpt: a retirement after two laps
claims.uk_excerpt: вибув після двох кіл
claims.review_question: Confirm lap-count semantics in F1DB and official classification before treating it as distance completed.

claims.en_excerpt: the Revs Institute archive establish the fatal accident
claims.uk_excerpt: архів Revs Institute підтверджують трагічні обставини
claims.review_question: The story names Revs Institute without a direct linked locator; obtain exact document, URL and relevant passage.

claims.en_excerpt: Jochen Mass was classified the winner
claims.uk_excerpt: Переможцем оголосили Йохена Масса
claims.review_question: Confirm winner and circuit against the classification.

claims.en_excerpt: The race continued briefly and was then stopped after 29 laps
claims.uk_excerpt: Гонка ще тривала кілька кіл, після чого її зупинили на 29-му колі
claims.review_question: Independently verify the fatal spectator accident, subsequent race stoppage and reduced points; classification alone does not establish the full chronology.

claims.en_excerpt: The drivers arrived for the 1975 Spanish Grand Prix at Montjuïc already worried about the circuit's guardrails
claims.uk_excerpt: Пілоти приїхали на Гран-прі Іспанії 1975 року в Монжуїку вже стурбовані станом захисних огорож
claims.review_question: Identify specific documented safety failures rather than relying on a broad retrospective judgment.
